title: BestChatBot Blocks Order Lookups When Identity Fails. By Design. #shorts
description:
If your chatbot pulls order data without verifying who's asking, that's a data leak.

BestChatBot only runs personal actions when the visitor is signed in and the token is valid. Expired or tampered? It blocks. No fallback. 

Try it free at https://bestchatbot.io 
#chatbotmemory #ecommerce #datasecurity
